round_start: [exhales] Okay... here we go again. Stay sharp, everybody!
[determined] Lights are up, gates are shut. Let's see what crawls out tonight.
[tense] Here they come. Here they come! Hold the line!
Alright, round's on. Don't get cocky, and don't get dead.
[muttering] Oh, great. More of 'em. Of course there's more of 'em.
round_clear: [sighs] Alright... that's the last of 'em. For now. Everybody still breathing? Tell me everybody's still breathing.
[relieved laugh] Heh, still standing. Barely, but still standing. Let's patch that fence while we can.
[exhales slowly] Quiet. Too quiet. I don't trust it, but I'll take it. Load up, people.
[tired] Oh man, my hands are shaking. Okay. Okay, breathe. Next one's gonna be worse, isn't it?
[breathing hard] Phew... okay, okay. [tired laugh] Gotta catch my breath real quick. These things just don't quit!
reload: Gotta reload, gotta reload, hold 'em off!
[breathing hard] Reloading... come on, come on.
Hang on, just a sec, reloading!
[muttering] Come on, come on, load, you stupid thing.
low_ammo: [worried] I'm running low here, almost out!
Ammo's getting thin, guys. Don't waste any.
Ah, jeez, I'm nearly dry over here!
[tense] Low on ammo! Anybody got a spare mag?
dry: [panicked] Come on, come on... nothing! I'm outta ammo!
Ah, damn it, empty! Switching, switching!
[groans] Of course. Of course it's empty.
kill: [through gritted teeth] And stay dead this time.
streak: [shouting] Yes! Yes! That's what I'm talking about! Who else wants some?!
[laughs] Look at 'em drop! Come on, don't be shy, line up!
[excited] Whoo! I'm on fire here! Nobody touch my spot!
[panting, grinning] Ha ha! Keep 'em coming! I'm just getting warmed up!
[shouting] Boom! Boom! Boom! Is that all you've got?!
[breathless laugh] Oh, that felt good. Do that again, do that again!
[excited, shouting] HA! Get some! [laughs] Come on, who's next?! I got plenty more where that came from!
close_call: [gasps] Whoa! Too close, way too close!
[breathing hard] Jeez, that one nearly had me. Back off, back off!
Okay, I'm hurt, I'm hurt, I need a second here!
[strained] I can't take much more of this. Watch my back, somebody!
[shaky] Oh, that's not good, that's not good at all.
hurt: [groans in pain] Ah, son of a... ugh!
downed: [weak, gasping] No... no, no... I'm down... somebody... help...
[groaning, wheezing] Aah... I can't get up. Help me. Please!
[faint] Not like this... not like this...
[pained, fading] I'm hit bad... somebody get me up...
revived: [gasping, coughing] Thanks. Thank you. I owe you one.
[breathing hard] Whoa... okay, I'm up. I'm up. Good looking out!
[coughs] Jeez, I thought that was it for me. Thanks for the pull!
[wheezing] Oh, wow. Thank you. Seriously. Let's go, let's go!
[groans, then laughs weakly] You came back for me. Heh. I won't forget that.
teammate_down: [shouting] Man down! We got somebody down!
Oh no, no, they're down! Somebody get over there!
[urgent] Hang on, I'm coming! Hold on!
[alarmed] They got one of us! I'm going in, cover me!
Stay with me, stay with me! I'll get you up!
buy_weapon: [pleased] Oh, now we're talking. Come to mama.
Ha, that's more like it. Let's see what this baby can do.
[impressed] Nice. Real nice. Feels good in my hands.
Alright, that's a proper piece. Let's put it to work.
buy_big: [excited] Oh, that cost a fortune, but boy, it's worth every penny!
[laughs] Spent it all! Hope this thing's as good as it looks!
[grinning] Now THAT is a gun. Everybody back up, big girl coming through!
[laughs] Wallet's empty, but I've never felt so safe.
door: [grunts] Door's open! Watch the new angle!
Alright, that opens things up. Eyes front, people.
[wary] Okay... let's see what's behind door number one.
Door's open! More room to run, more room to get flanked.
[low] Easy now. Easy. Don't know what's in there.
power_on: [relieved] Yes! Lights are on! Power's back, baby!
[exhales] There she goes. Generator's humming again.
[laughs] Come on, come on, stay lit. I hate the dark.
Power's up! Keep her fed, or we're toast.
[chuckles] Nothing like a little light to cheer a girl up.
power_low: [worried] Generator's coughing! Somebody get it some fuel!
Uh-oh, the lights are flickering. Fuel, we need fuel!
[tense] If that thing dies, we're in the dark. Feed it, feed it!
[groans] Aw, no. Power's gone. Everybody stay close!
boss_arrive: [stunned, whispering] Oh no. Oh, that's big. That is really, really big.
[shouting] Look at the size of that thing! Everybody focus fire, focus fire!
[breathless] Okay, new plan. Run. Maybe run. No, shoot first, then run.
[nervous laugh] You've gotta be kidding me. What do they feed that thing?
[low, grim] Here's the big one. Stay together, and don't stop shooting.
boss_dead: [shouting, triumphant] Yes! Go down! Go down, you big ugly... yes!
[panting, laughing] Is it dead? Tell me it's dead. Oh, thank God it's dead.
[breathless laugh] We did it! We actually did it! I can't believe that worked!
[exhaling] Whew. Okay. That one I'm gonna feel in the morning.
idle: [quiet, thoughtful] You ever think about how this place used to be a drive-in? People came to watch movies and eat popcorn. Now look at us.
[sighs] Anyone else hear that? ...No? Just me. Great. I'm losing it.
[tired] Sorry, I was humming. Habit. My mother used to hum when things got bad.
[low] Man, what I wouldn't give for a hot coffee and a bed that doesn't smell like gasoline.
[tired chuckle] Funny thing is, I used to hate quiet. Now it scares me more than the noise.
level_up: [grinning] Climbing the ladder, one rung at a time!
[laughs] Moving up in the world, folks!
tier_up: [shouting, triumphant] New rank! Hear that brass?!
[whooping] Whoo! Straight up the chain of command!
[proud] Look at me. Stripes and everything.
unlock: [pleased] Ooh, something new. Don't mind if I do.
[grins] Well, well. Look what I found.
challenge_done: [laughs] Ha! Nailed it. Put it on the board!
[chuckles] Scratch that one off the list.
poster_set: [delighted] The whole set! Every poster on the wall!
[laughs] That's the last poster. Now it looks right.
card: [chuckles] Fresh card in the deck. Deal me in.
emblem: [proud] Got me a new emblem. Wear it loud.
[grinning] Shiny new badge. Look at that shine.
first_game: [cheerful] First feature of the day. Let's go!
[upbeat] Doors are open. First show's on me.
